content.thinking:
My fixer script itself has a syntax error because of the `")]` inside a string. Let me write the fixer to a file instead of a heredoc, being careful with quoting. Actually, let me just rewrite the test file entirely with a cleaner approach: build the cases programmatically with helper functions so parentheses are simpler.

Let me restructure: instead of `S([tr([dg(...)])])`, I'll define a helper `T(events)` that returns the full request bytes: `json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[{"id":"t","config":CFG,"events":events}]}).encode()`. Then each case is `("name", T([...]))` — much less nesting.

arguments.command:
cat > /app/tmp/t/test_invalid2.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/tmp/t")
from run import expect_invalid

ok = True
CFG = {
    "early": False, "overlap": "reject", "buffer_packets": 2, "idle_ms": 0,
    "max_streams_bidi": 4, "max_streams_uni": 4, "max_stream_data": 32,
    "max_data": 64, "crypto_limit": 32, "sent": {"I": [], "H": [], "A": []},
}

def T(events, cfg=None):
    return json.dumps({"version": 1, "traces": [
        {"id": "t", "config": cfg if cfg is not None else CFG, "events": events}]}).encode()

def key(t, level, action): return {"t": t, "op": "key", "level": level, "action": action}
def tick(t): return {"t": t, "op": "tick"}
def dg(t, size, pkts): return {"t": t, "op": "datagram", "bytes": size, "packets": pkts}
def pkt(level, pn, auth, frames): return {"level": level, "pn": pn, "auth": auth, "frames": frames}
def P(**kw):
    f = {"type": "PADDING"}
    f.update(kw); return f

cases = [
 ("event missing t", T([{"op":"tick"}])),
 ("event missing op", T([{"t":0}])),
 ("event extra key", T([{"t":0,"op":"tick","x":1}])),
 ("tick with level", T([{"t":0,"op":"tick","level":"I"}])),
 ("t negative", T([{"t":-1,"op":"tick"}])),
 ("t too big", T([{"t":1000000000001,"op":"tick"}])),
 ("t bool", T([{"t":True,"op":"tick"}])),
 ("t decreasing", T([{"t":5,"op":"tick"},{"t":4,"op":"tick"}])),
 ("op bogus", T([{"t":5,"op":"bogus"}])),
 ("op not string", T([{"t":0,"op":1}])),
 ("key bad level", T([key(0,"X","install")])),
 ("key bad action", T([key(0,"I","reinstall")])),
 ("key missing action", T([{"t":0,"op":"key","level":"I"}])),
 ("key extra", T([{"t":0,"op":"key","level":"I","action":"install","x":1}])),
 ("level lowercase", T([key(0,"i","install")])),
 ("datagram missing bytes", T([{"t":0,"op":"datagram","packets":[pkt("I",0,True,[])]}])),
 ("bytes negative", T([dg(0,-1,[pkt("I",0,True,[])])])),
 ("bytes 65536", T([dg(0,65536,[pkt("I",0,True,[])])])),
 ("bytes bool", T([dg(0,True,[pkt("I",0,True,[])])])),
 ("packets empty", T([dg(0,1200,[])])),
 ("packets 17", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",i,True,[]) for i in range(17)])])),
 ("packets not list", T([dg(0,1200,{"a":1})])),
 ("packet not object", T([dg(0,1200,[1])])),
 ("packet missing frames", T([dg(0,1200,[{"level":"I","pn":0,"auth":True}])])),
 ("packet extra key", T([dg(0,1200,[{"level":"I","pn":0,"auth":True,"frames":[],"x":1}])])),
 ("packet bad level", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("Q",0,True,[])])])),
 ("pn negative", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",-1,True,[])])])),
 ("pn too big", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",4611686018427387904,True,[])])])),
 ("pn bool", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",True,True,[])])])),
 ("auth int", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,1,[])])])),
 ("auth null", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,None,[])])])),
 ("frames not list", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,{})])])),
 ("frames 65", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[P()]*65)])])),
 ("frame not object", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[1])])])),
 ("frame missing type", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{}])])])),
 ("frame unknown name", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"BOGUS"}])])])),
 ("frame type not str", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":1}])])])),
 ("padding extra key", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[P(x=1)])])])),
 ("ping extra", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"PING","id":0}])])])),
 ("ack missing ranges", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"ACK"}])])])),
 ("ack ranges not list", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"ACK","ranges":{}}])])])),
 ("ack 33 ranges", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"ACK","ranges":[[i,i] for i in range(33)]}])])])),
 ("ack bad endpoint", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"ACK","ranges":[[0,4611686018427387904]]}])])])),
 ("ack negative", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"ACK","ranges":[[-1,0]]}])])])),
 ("ack range 1 elem", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"ACK","ranges":[[1]]}])])])),
 ("ack range 3 elem", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"ACK","ranges":[[1,2,3]]}])])])),
 ("crypto missing offset", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","data_hex":""}])])])),
 ("crypto offset big", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":4611686018427387904,"data_hex":""}])])])),
 ("crypto hex odd", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":"a"}])])])),
 ("crypto hex upper", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":"AA"}])])])),
 ("crypto hex nonhex", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":"zz"}])])])),
 ("crypto hex 2049B", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":"ab"*2049}])])])),
 ("crypto hex not str", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":123}])])])),
 ("crypto hex null", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":None}])])])),
 ("stream missing fin", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"STREAM","id":0,"offset":0,"data_hex":""}])])])),
 ("stream id big", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"STREAM","id":4611686018427387904,"offset":0,"data_hex":"","fin":False}])])])),
 ("stream fin int", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"STREAM","id":0,"offset":0,"data_hex":"","fin":0}])])])),
 ("stream extra", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"STREAM","id":0,"offset":0,"data_hex":"","fin":False,"x":1}])])])),
 ("reset missing fs", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"RESET_STREAM","id":0}])])])),
 ("reset fs big", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"RESET_STREAM","id":0,"final_size":4611686018427387904}])])])),
 ("stop missing id", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"STOP_SENDING"}])])])),
 ("close missing code", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"CLOSE","app":False}])])])),
 ("close app int", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"CLOSE","app":1,"code":0}])])])),
 ("close code big", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"CLOSE","app":False,"code":4611686018427387904}])])])),
 ("close code neg", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"CLOSE","app":False,"code":-1}])])])),
 ("hd extra", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"HANDSHAKE_DONE","x":1}])])])),
 ("unknown extra", T([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"UNKNOWN","x":1}])])])),
]
for name, raw in cases: ok &= expect_invalid(name, raw)

# structural totals
ok &= expect_invalid("20001 events", T([tick(0)]*20001))
pk = pkt("I",0,True,[])
evs = [dg(0,1200,[pk]*16)] + [dg(1,1200,[pk]*16)]*1249 + [dg(2,1200,[pk])]
ok &= expect_invalid("20001 packets", T(evs))
evs = []
n = 0
for i in range(1000):
    evs.append(dg(i,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[P()]*60)])); n += 60
evs.append(dg(1000,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[P()])]))
ok &= expect_invalid("60001 frames", T(evs))
big = "ab"*2048
evs = []; n = 0; i = 0
while n <= 2*1024*1024:
    evs.append(dg(i,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":big}])]))
    n += 2048; i += 1
ok &= expect_invalid("too much data", T(evs))
print("data events:", len(evs), n)
print("ALL PASS" if ok else "SOME FAILED")
PYEOF
